findings.title: Keyboard settings-panel surface is dead: S/arrows/Enter never reach the phase-1 emit switch
findings.detail: The phase-1 keys buffer collects only P/Space/D/T/M/Esc; S/Up/Down/Left/Right/Enter fall to `case:`. Every new emit case (the whole panel-open key branch AND `case .S -> Toggle_Settings`) is unreachable. Keyboard cannot open/navigate/adjust/close the panel; the panel footer 'S / tap chip to close' and the PR's 'keyboard (S, arrows, Enter, Esc)' claim are false as shipped. The input_parity_settings_panel keyboard leg therefore passes vacuously (its S,Down,Enter,S script never opens the panel; it asserts only 'ends closed' + empty command stream).
findings.recommended_fix: Collect the panel keys into the buffer (grow to [11]Key or a second pass over events). FIX HAZARD: phase-2 still maps S -> Set_Lane(Standard) on raw events, so merely collecting S would dual-dispatch (open panel + silently reassign the selected class's QoS lane when a pipe is selected) — three lenses tripped on exactly this. Resolve S ownership in the same change (suppress the phase-2 lane key when the settings intent fires, or rebind settings to a free key and update the QoS hint). Then make the parity scenario assert non-vacuous panel state.

findings.title: Touch can only step UI scale UP — a one-way ratchet to 150%
findings.detail: Row taps deliver delta 0 -> step=+1, clamped at UI_SCALE_COUNT-1. Keyboard Left/Right and pad D-pad Left/Right emit ±1, but no touch path emits -1. A touch-only player who reaches 150% is stuck there (palette wraps, scale clamps), and the step persists to ~/.pp-settings.bin across relaunch. Breaks the 5.4 parity doctrine on the story's own settings surface.
findings.recommended_fix: Make the scale row wrap on touch (100->125->150->100, matching the palette cycle), or split the row into -/+ hit zones.

findings.title: Settings persistence (save/load/corrupt-file defaults) has zero automated coverage
findings.detail: No test in the repo references settings_load/settings_save/scale_of/step_of. The corrupt/truncated/foreign-version/checksum/range fallback-to-defaults contract (spec I/O matrix; briefing flag-for-verification) is entirely unpinned — a dropped range guard or broken checksum would ship silently. P1 behaviour at 0%; repo doctrine is 'everything testable headless, is'.
findings.recommended_fix: Add a unit test over the byte format: round-trip save/load, plus corrupt legs (bad magic, wrong version, checksum mismatch, out-of-range palette/motion/scale) asserting DEFAULT_A11Y.

findings.title: x1.50: crisis banner occludes the forecast panel (23px overlap)
findings.detail: At x1.50/1280x720 the banner spans x 415..985 (card 660 + pads) while the forecast panel starts at x 962 — 23px of the weather card (WEATHER REPORT title + the streaming_surge x10 NOW line) renders behind the banner. No overlap at x1.00/x1.25. Vision-read confirms clipped/hidden text. Violates E9.3 'chrome stays legible at each step' at the knob's own max step, in the crisis moment both surfaces exist for.
findings.recommended_fix: Clamp/stack: when the scaled banner would cross the forecast panel's left edge, drop the banner below the forecast (banner_y already takes a y_base) or narrow the card at x1.50.

findings.title: x1.25/x1.50: QoS action row buttons overlap and mis-hit — most of Revert fires Edit-weights/Auto
findings.detail: Slot 0 scales ([Edit weights] at hud offsets, width hud_f(120)); slot 1 stays unscaled (QOS_PANEL_X+136, w 90). At x1.50 slot 0 spans x 30..210, slot 1 x 148..238: 62px of Revert lies inside slot 0's hit rect, and slot 0 is hit-tested FIRST — clicking most of the visible Revert button opens the manual editor (or reverts-to-auto) instead. 27px already at x1.25. The manual editor's preset chips + nudge rects are unscaled too (small hit targets exactly when the user needs them larger).
findings.recommended_fix: Thread hud()/hud_f() through qos_action_rect slot 1, qos_preset_chip_rect, qos_nudge_rect (draw + hit already share them — one fix each).

findings.title: Advisory test gate: FAIL
findings.detail: P0: negative legs missing (palcheck separation oracle; the W1-drift class has one, the a11y oracle does not). P1 ~60%: scaling ~55% (x1.25 unpinned; no hit-test runs at any scale >1.00), settings-panel input ~65% (shallow/vacuous parity), persistence 0%. Overall ~67% across the 8 traced behaviours. All three FAIL clauses trip.
findings.recommended_fix: Land the pinned legs above: settings unit tests, palcheck negative control, a x1.25 golden or scaled-hit parity leg, non-vacuous panel parity.

findings.title: SLA gauge rows: text scales, row pitch (16px) + hit rect (18px) do not — overlapping lines + hit drift at x1.25+
findings.detail: hud(16) text on an unscaled 16px pitch: at x1.50 the 24px gauge lines overlap by ~8px (20px at x1.25 by ~4px) — illegible rows exactly in the mode whose AC is 'chrome stays legible at each step'. The focus-row hit rect (740x18 unscaled) no longer matches the drawn text.
findings.recommended_fix: Route QOS-row pitch + rect through hud(); recheck chip collision (see notes).

findings.title: draw_hud top-left + game-over blocks: scaled fonts on unscaled y positions
findings.detail: Title (y=10), hint (y=36), score (y=56), lead line (y=76), win/lose toast (y=68) + retry hint (y=104) keep x1.00 y positions while their fonts scale — at x1.50 the 33px title bottom (43) overlaps the hint row (36); the 45px toast bottom (113) overlaps the retry row (104).
findings.recommended_fix: Scale the y anchors through hud() or derive each row from the previous row's scaled height.

findings.title: Demolish popover scales width but not height/text — pipe-popover button rides up over the title at x1.25+
findings.detail: popover_rect scales W + offsets via hud_f but takes h raw (64/92); all popover text stays 15/14px. At x1.50 the pipe-popover button top = pop.y+64-54 = y+10 while the title occupies y+8..23 — the button (drawn after) covers the title. Node popover (h=92) clears. Draw+hit stay consistent (shared rects).
findings.recommended_fix: hud_f() the heights and the text sizes.

findings.title: x1.25 step unpinned; no hit-test/parity run at any scale >1.00; spec's '1152x648 AC-pinned' checkbox has no exercising path
findings.detail: Goldens pin x1.00 (existing) and x1.50-draw (a11y_scale); x1.25 has nothing. Every harness path renders at 1280x720, so the spec AC 'scale x1.50 at 1152x648, no HUD overlap anywhere — AC-pinned' is claimed-pinned but never exercised anywhere.
findings.recommended_fix: Add a x1.125/x1.25 golden or a scaled-rect parity leg; either exercise the min-window AC or un-pin the claim.

findings.title: The 25/25 parity scenarios never run under any a11y mode
findings.detail: 'Full input parity holds under every mode' is construction-argued only. Palette/reduced-motion provably never touch input mapping (grep: zero refs in app/input); ui_scale does move hit rects (settings chip width is mode-dependent), so the under-scale leg is the real residual risk.
findings.recommended_fix: Drive the parity matrix once per a11y mode (or at minimum at x1.50) — the a11y demos prove sim-hash identity, not input parity.

findings.title: input_parity_settings_panel is shallow: panel_row captured but never asserted; legs end on divergent rows by construction
findings.detail: kbd/pad scripts end at panel_row 1, touch at 0 (opening resets to 0; closing does not). The scenario asserts only 'panel closed' + empty commands, so the PR's 'identical end input-state' holds only for panel_open. Settings_Activate's app-side effect (palette wrap, scale clamp, persist) runs nowhere.
findings.recommended_fix: Assert panel_row per-script expectation (or reset row on close and assert 0); add an exec-level activate test.

findings.title: palcheck separation oracle has no committed negative leg
findings.detail: Perkins verified the oracle DOES bite at this sha (tampered deutan pair -> 'FAIL a11y separation (deutan; min sim-dist 0.0)', exit 1 — restored after). But only the positive leg is committed: a future edit that zeroes a threshold or breaks cvd_simulate passes CI silently.
findings.recommended_fix: Commit the poison pair as a self-test leg (expect-FAIL fixture), mirroring the W1 drift-rejection pattern.

findings.title: Muted-audio captions contract ('muted != silent') not pinned despite the spec's 'pin it'
findings.detail: The 7.2 seam keeps captions live while muted (the a11y contract) and the spec I/O matrix explicitly says 'existing contract, pin it' — no test covers a muted run's captions.
findings.recommended_fix: One audio_test case: mute, fire crisis + arrival, expect the caption stream unaffected.

findings.title: pulse_read documented as the ONE motion-gate seam; crisis.odin hand-rolls a second gate
findings.detail: Behavior matches (both pin static) but the crisis phase math ((tick+b)%16) differs from pulse_factor's, so it could not call pulse_read verbatim; a future gate change must be made twice.
findings.recommended_fix: Route through one seam or fix the comment/PR claim.

findings.title: Unused `import "core:strings"` in palette.odin
findings.detail: Zero strings.* references; build/lint gates stay green (the lens's 'build fails' claim was false — CI 10/10).
findings.recommended_fix: Delete the import.

findings.title: step_of + PALETTE_MODE_COUNT are dead exports
findings.detail: step_of's comment promises a panel/save use that never landed; PALETTE_MODE_COUNT duplicates inline enum-max arithmetic.
findings.recommended_fix: Use them or drop them.

findings.title: Settings chip shows no reduced-motion indicator
findings.detail: `scaled` includes reduced_motion but a11y_chip_text has no motion case — motion-only active state reads 'A11Y SETTINGS (S)' (with the darker active bg only).
findings.recommended_fix: Add an 'A11Y: RED. MOTION' case.

findings.title: demolish_button_rect's nil-default view silently reproduces the unscaled rect
findings.detail: No nil callers today; the opt-out default is a second source of truth waiting for an omission.
findings.recommended_fix: Require the view parameter.

findings.title: parse_mode_table sets roofs_set before validating elements — a malformed entry yields an opaque BLACK roof
findings.detail: roofs_set=true when the array has len 4; a non-array/non-int element falls back to {0,0,0,255} (opaque black — the lens said transparent; corrected). Contradicts the keep-base-on-malformed doctrine elsewhere.
findings.recommended_fix: Validate all 4 elements before setting roofs_set.

findings.title: Settings checksum is an additive u8 sum of 3 payload bytes
findings.detail: Sum-preserving corruption (e.g. palette+1, motion-1 mod 256) passes the checksum and range checks — silently wrong persisted settings. Fail-visible doctrine accepts this; not a security boundary.
findings.recommended_fix: A stronger checksum (CRC8/FNV byte) costs nothing — optional.

findings.title: Derivation script dead helpers: scale_lum/mix defined, never called
findings.detail: Leftover search machinery; the script still reproduces the shipped tables exactly (verified byte-for-byte).
findings.recommended_fix: Delete or wire them.

findings.title: Spec doc drift: intent names, 0.99-vs-1.0 motion pin, comma demo verb
findings.detail: Spec says Settings_Toggle/Panel_Navigate/Panel_Activate/Scale_Step (shipped: Toggle_Settings/Settings_Navigate/Settings_Activate); spec pins reduced-motion at 'mid-envelope (e.g. 0.99)' while the ruling+code pin 1.0 full; spec documents 'a11y <mode>[,<mode>]' — the parser implements 'a11y palette|reduced|scale' subcommands (combining works via separate lines).
findings.recommended_fix: True up the spec to the shipped names/values.

findings.title: Chip/SLA bottom-left adjacency: the 3rd gauge row collides at x1.25+
findings.detail: Today's 2-class roster leaves the chip exactly adjacent; the planned 3rd row (9 classes full-game) lands on the chip at x1.25/x1.50 and steals its clicks.
findings.recommended_fix: Move the chip or reserve the band when this bites.

findings.title: start_run never resets panel_open/panel_row
findings.detail: Unreachable today (every mapper gates Game_Over before the panel; opening pauses the run) — defense-in-depth only.
findings.recommended_fix: Reset both in start_run alongside the other input state.

findings.title: Panel open while placement armed (pad Y + mouse): ui-press is gated on placing<0, so modal rows are dead for the mouse until ESC
findings.detail: Mixed pad+mouse combo: pad Y opens the panel mid-placement; mouse left-presses skip on_ui_press (placing gate) and the panel-open branch suppresses the rest — rows/chip unclickable. Touch unaffected (its panel branch calls on_ui_press directly); keyboard ESC escapes.
findings.recommended_fix: While panel_open, run on_ui_press regardless of placing.

findings.title: _pr_body.md committed tracked at the repo root
findings.detail: PR-body scratch shipped in the tree.
findings.recommended_fix: git rm --cached (or move under _bmad-output).

findings.title: Orphaned '// 16. pause' comment sits above the settings-panel scenario in parity.odin
findings.detail: The settings scenario (#16) was inserted above the pause scenario without renumbering the comment.
findings.recommended_fix: Renumber.

findings.title: Caption strip / settings chip+panel never enter any T2 capture
findings.detail: draw_hud is outside the capture path by design (capture-stability contract) — the scaled strip/chip/panel rendering is unpinned. Low risk (pure HUD chrome).
findings.recommended_fix: Accept, or add an app-layer capture gate later.

findings.title: No presence/content scans for the a11y_reduced + a11y_scale goldens; a11y demo-verb parse-error legs untested
findings.location: harness/palcheck.odin section 4 (palette modes only) + harness/demo.odin a11y verb
findings.detail: palcheck scans Deutan/Protan/Tritan frames only; reduced/scale rely on the T2 hash alone; the new parser's error paths (bad mode name, bad pct) have no negative tests.
findings.recommended_fix: Extend palcheck or a demo-parse test with the error legs.

findings.title: palcheck picks the 40-vs-48 threshold by pr[0] color-value equality, not pair identity
findings.detail: If a future mode edit sets a signal token equal to a map token's VALUE, that pair silently falls under the looser 40 threshold.
findings.recommended_fix: Key the threshold on the pair's token indices, not colors.

findings.title: QoS panel hint still advertises S as a lane key ('[1/2 + E/S/B]') — accurate today, but the panel footer and PR claim S opens settings
findings.detail: As shipped S remains the QoS Standard-lane key (the settings binding is dead — see blocker 1); once the keyboard surface is fixed, S cannot be both. The two in-repo texts already disagree.
findings.recommended_fix: Resolve with blocker 1's ownership fix; update both texts.
